extracted.name: Lisa's Chocolate Chocolate Chip Cake
extracted.description: Super moist and decadent, but easy-to-make cake! Dust with confectioner's sugar if desired.
ingredient_lines: 1 (3.9 ounce) package instant chocolate pudding mix
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a Bundt pan.
Combine cake mix, pudding mix, oil, eggs, water, sour cream, and vanilla. Beat until smooth. Stir in chocolate chips. Pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour. Allow to cool.
